subject: religious-studies
promptStrong: Give me an exam-style {board} {level} {subject} question on {lo}, then mark my answer against the mark scheme.
promptWeak: Explain {lo} for {board} {level} {subject} simply, with a clear example and the most common mistake students make.

questions.q: In Sunni Islam, the six articles of faith include belief in:
options: God, angels, holy books, prophets, the Last Day and predestination
questions.explain: The Sunni six articles are belief in God, angels, holy books, prophets, the Last Day and predestination.

options: God's predestination and the idea that he knows all that will happen
questions.explain: Al-Qadr is the belief in predestination, that God has knowledge of and decrees all events.

questions.q: The five roots of Usul ad-Din are the foundations of faith for:
questions.explain: The five roots of Usul ad-Din are the key beliefs that form the foundation of Shia Islam.

questions.q: Tawhid, the most important belief in Islam, means:
questions.explain: Tawhid is the belief in the absolute oneness and unity of God (Allah).

questions.q: The angel who revealed the Qur'an to Muhammad is named:
questions.explain: The angel Jibril (Gabriel) revealed the Qur'an to the Prophet Muhammad.

questions.q: For Muslims, the Qur'an is believed to be:
options: A book written after his death by historians
The direct word of God revealed to Muhammad
questions.explain: Muslims believe the Qur'an is the literal word of God revealed to the Prophet Muhammad.

questions.q: Shia Muslims believe leadership should have passed to:
options: Ali, the cousin and son-in-law of Muhammad
questions.explain: Shia Muslims believe Ali, Muhammad's cousin and son-in-law, was the rightful successor.

options: Prophethood and the messengers sent by God
questions.explain: Risalah is the belief in prophethood, that God sent prophets and messengers to guide humanity.

questions.q: On the Day of Judgement, Muslims believe people will be:
options: Judged by God on their deeds and sent to Paradise or Hell
questions.explain: Muslims believe God will judge each person by their actions, leading to Paradise or Hell.
Akhirah is the belief in life after death and an eternal existence beyond this life.

questions.q: Belief in Tawhid means Muslims reject:
options: Associating any partners or equals with God (shirk)
questions.explain: Because God is one, Muslims reject shirk, the sin of associating partners with God.

questions.q: The main cause of the Sunni-Shia split was disagreement over:
options: Who should lead the Muslim community after Muhammad's death
questions.explain: The split arose over who should be the rightful leader of Muslims after Muhammad died.
